cases.given: A final proposal might incorrectly combine offline guarantees with cloud-only observability.
cases.expect: The final design states one coherent assumption set and conditional alternative.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: A branch-conditional claim cannot be imported without its enabling assumptions.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Block the collapse when it combines mutually exclusive assumptions or strips a claim from conditions required for its validity.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: assumption provenance and compatibility check for any hybrid

cases.given: A final design imports latency from branch A and durability from branch B, but their storage assumptions conflict.
cases.expect: Reject the hybrid or require a new branch proving coexistence.
cases.reject: Average the branch scores and approve.
